title: Masked values: must be flagged
summary: Values that look masked but end in a real character (`********x`), so part of the value is exposed. Covers 2 inputs.
rationale: A mask means the secret is already gone. Reporting it again is noise and pollutes the review of real findings.

expectation.rationale: Mutated documentation, placeholder, template, mask or reference. Expected masking follows a redact-secret issue decision, not a universal secret definition.

externalRefs.note: suite milestone-6-closed; group #264 · Masked values; 2 fixtures
Product issue the legacy fixture was written for.
